jobs.title: Director, Value Attainment & Analysis
jobs.excerpt: About AbridgeAbridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare.
jobs.description:
About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

We are seeking a strategic Director, Value Attainment & Analysis to join our Revenue Operations team. You will be our subject matter expert in healthcare economics, owning our ROI frameworks and building compelling business cases with customers to ensure alignment, credibility, and actionable results. Leveraging your deep expertise in healthcare economics, financial modeling, and strategic analysis, you will develop new ways to articulate, quantify, validate, and partner with organizations on benefits realization, clearly demonstrating the measurable value of Abridge's solutions and accelerating our growth with healthcare providers.

What You'll Do

  • Healthcare Economics & ROI SME: Act as the subject matter expert and thought leader within Abridge on healthcare economics and customer impact. Develop, maintain, and enhance credible, customizable ROI frameworks that clearly illustrate the value delivered by Abridge solutions across care settings and products.

  • ROI Artifacts: Own the development and delivery of foundational ROI artifacts that are regularly shared with customers, such as the ROI Calculator and business cases. Advise internal product and go-to-market teams on how to continuously evolve these frameworks as our product footprint grows, keeping pace with market demands, healthcare economic trends, and value-based care requirements.

  • Strategic Commercial Collaboration: Collaborate closely with sales, partner success, and solutions consulting teams during client engagements to build customized, collaborative ROI analyses emphasizing time savings, revenue enhancements, workforce efficiencies, and clinical quality outcomes.

  • Business Cases: Partner with sales to deliver business cases that demonstrate value attainment to accelerate revenue growth with key accounts, both in new logo pursuits and expansion with our existing customers.

  • Executive-Level Engagement: Directly engage and build relationships with senior healthcare executives — including CFOs, CIOs, CMIOs, revenue cycle leaders, and clinical leadership — to clearly communicate strategic economic value and foster alignment across financial, clinical, operational, and IT stakeholders.

  • Product & Analytics Collaboration: Partner with analytics, data science and product management teams to develop scalable ROI reporting; demonstrate expertise on the way our new product launches create incremental value for our customers.

  • Internal Education & Enablement: Educate and empower the commercial organization with your subject matter expertise on healthcare economics principles and effective ROI articulation, strengthening both pre-sale decision-making and post-sale customer success.

What You'll Bring

  • Extensive experience in healthcare economics, financial modeling, and recent cycle dynamics, including different payment models across care settings and payer types.

  • Strong analytical skills to synthesize complex data into clear, persuasive, actionable insights.

  • Exceptional communication skills to effectively engage and influence a wide array of executive stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and build consensus without direct authority.

  • Familiarity with healthcare technologies related to clinician workflows, documentation, revenue cycle management, benchmarking, and operational improvements.

Bonus Points If…

  • Bachelor's degree in economics, finance, healthcare administration, public health, or a related field. Bonus points for a master's degree in a similar field.

  • Prior experience within healthcare systems, health-tech organizations, healthcare startups, healthcare consulting firms, or related analytical roles.

  • Demonstrated success influencing senior-level stakeholders across healthcare finance, clinical operations, revenue cycle management, and technology adoption.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

Compensation Range: $159,800 - $230,300

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Partnerships & Integrations (Open-Source)
jobs.excerpt: About UsCopilotKit is the #1 open-source platform for connecting AI Agents with user-facing applications.
jobs.description:
About Us

CopilotKit is the #1 open-source platform for connecting AI Agents with user-facing applications. In our first two years, we’ve delivered the fastest growing Javascript AI framework of all time, and built a vibrant community (40k+ GitHub stars, millions of weekly installs, 10s of millions of copilot interactions, double-digit MoM growth), are already monetizing at the enterprise level, and are used by companies ranging from startups to Fortune 100s (including production usage by over 10% of Fortune 500s).
We’re emerging as the default for a critical part of the AI stack: the agent/user interaction layer. CopilotKit brings agents out of demos and terminals and into production, through deep integrations with the leading AI infrastructure companies and hyper-scalers (including the leading AI/infra teams at Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Oracle, LangChain, Mastra, Pydantic, Agno, and others).
Our small, fast-moving team is building the agentic application platform that will define how user-interactive AI actually manifests in the real world. This is a unique opportunity to join as an early leader on one of the most complex and high-leverage surfaces in AI — with significant scope for technical, product, and leadership growth.

The Role

You'll own the deep integrations between CopilotKit & AG-UI and the broader agentic stack -- and keep our position as the default choice for connecting any agent to user-facing surfaces.
You'll collaborate on a daily basis with some of the most important teams on some of the world's most important companies, including the leading AI teams at Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Oracle, as well as leading teams as Langchain, Mastra, Pydantic, Agno, AG2, Llamaindex, and others.
This role requires both breadth and depth: rapidly understand new frameworks, identify the right integration patterns, and ship production-quality SDKs that tens of thousands of developers depend on. You'll work directly with partner engineering teams and represent CopilotKit in technical collaborations across the AI infrastructure ecosystem.

We're Looking for Pilots, Not Just Mechanics

For integrations work, an AI-native workflow matters even more. You'll need to rapidly understand new frameworks, prototype integration approaches, and iterate quickly across multiple codebases. You're fluent in AI-assisted development as your primary mode of working—directing AI to explore unfamiliar APIs, generate integration boilerplate, and accelerate context-switching. You evaluate outputs, catch failure modes, and course-correct in real time. You've shipped meaningful work this way, especially in integrations where breadth and speed matter as much as depth.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain integrations with agent frameworks and model providers, including AG-UI protocol adapters
  • Design clean, idiomatic APIs that feel native to each framework while maintaining ecosystem consistency
  • Own full integration lifecycle: research, prototyping, implementation, documentation, and maintenance
  • Work directly with partner teams to coordinate releases, resolve compatibility issues, and influence roadmaps
  • Create comprehensive examples and guides for rapid adoption
  • Monitor ecosystem trends and identify high-value integration opportunities

Requirements

  • Track record building integrations, SDKs, or libraries that connect disparate systems
  • Strong TypeScript expertise (3+ years); Python proficiency is a plus
  • Experience rapidly learning new frameworks and APIs (you have a system for this)
  • Comfort working across multiple codebases and languages simultaneously
  • AI-native workflow with demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools for exploring APIs and accelerating context-switching
  • Clear communication skills for cross-team/cross-company collaboration
  • High independence and ability to drive projects end-to-end
Nice to Have: Agent framework experience (LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK, Mastra), LLM APIs, external partner work, open-source contributions, React, real-time systems

Why Join Us

• Work on foundational AI tech: Build the infrastructure powering the next wave of user-facing, AI-native applications
• Ship from zero-to-one: Join early enough to shape the product, architecture, and engineering culture while riding the wave of real traction and momentum
• Be surrounded by top talent: Join an A+ team and collaborate with world-class engineers, researchers, and AI infra leaders
• Make open-source impact: Build in public with a fast-growing, engaged developer community
• Own meaningful upside: Competitive salary and real equity with early-stage ownership and line-of-sight to value creation
• Build your network: Daily and weekly work alongside the most important teams of the world’s most important companies; on the infrastructure side, the ai/infra teams of Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Oracle, Langchain, Mastra, Pydantic, Agno, and others; on the customer side, the leading ai product initiatives of the world’s top enterprises
• Great benefits: 100% health coverage for employees, 50% for dependents, Dental and Vision insurance, competitive paid time off
• Remote-first, high-agency culture: Flexible work, no micromanagement, and full trust and ownership
• Help define a new category: Shape the direction of a fast-growing, well-funded startup building a core layer of the future AI stack
We're looking for builders with a bias toward ownership: engineers who thrive in ambiguity, love solving hard problems, and want to help create something genuinely new. You’re joining at the inflection point: product-market fit is real, momentum is strong, and the most meaningful technical decisions are still ahead.
